name: Geylang
summary: Central-east shophouse and HDB belt with fierce food density, Paya Lebar / Dakota adjacency, and a reputation that rewards block-level due diligence.
body: Geylang is the central-east shortlist for renters who want walkable food, shorter CBD hops than Tampines, and character shophouse / walk-up stock — with eyes open on estate variance. Paya Lebar Quarter / Dakota / Aljunied adjacency changes the feel block by block; some pockets are quiet family HDB, others run late with F&B and nightlife spillover. Housing spans HDB, older walk-ups, and newer condos toward Paya Lebar. Due diligence is non-negotiable: visit on a weeknight and a weekend night before you LOI, check flood-prone approaches on heavy-rain evenings, and ask bluntly about upstairs reno and neighbour smoke drift. Compare with Katong / Joo Chiat for lifestyle-east premiums, Bedok for quieter EWL value, and Kallang / Bendemeer when you want even more central-east interchange gravity.
